note: row (table.row0 + level) column i = the colour palette index i takes at that light. Level 0 is full light, level 31 the darkest. Each entry is the RGB of the nearest MASTER palette index, so the engine may use the colormap directly as colour. Column 0 is the transparent index: RGBA (0,0,0,0) in every row, so the engine needs no patch on load. Every other column is opaque.
